item.title: Database
item.description:
Overview link

Spring Boot 4.1.0 + MyBatis-Flex 1.11.7 integration. Provides auto-audit (createdAt, updatedAt), ID generation (UUID v4/v7, Snowflake), multi-tenancy, logical delete, and Flyway migration support — all with zero boilerplate.

Maven Dependency link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-database</artifactId>
</dependency>

Key Features link

  • Auto-audit — BaseEntityListener automatically populates createdAt/updatedAt
  • ID Generation — UUID v4 (random), UUID v7 (time-ordered), Snowflake (distributed)
  • Multi-tenancy — TenantContextHolder + TenantInterceptor per-request isolation
  • Logical Delete — deleted = 0/1 via MyBatis-Flex built-in support
  • Flyway Migrations — LoadUpFlywayAutoConfiguration with loadup.flyway.* properties

Configuration link

loadup:
  database:
    id-strategy: uuid_v7    # uuid_v4 | uuid_v7 | snowflake
  flyway:
    enabled: true
    locations: classpath:db/migration
    baseline-on-migrate: true
    migrate-at-start: true

Related Documents link

  • ARCHITECTURE.md — Design decisions and extension points

item.title: Cache
item.description:
Overview link

Unified caching abstraction with API/binder pattern. Supports Caffeine (local, high-performance) and Redis/Redisson (distributed, shared) as interchangeable backends. Includes anti-avalanche, anti-breakdown, and anti-penetration safeguards.

Module Structure link

Module Purpose
loadup-components-cache-api SPI interfaces (CacheBinder, CacheBinding), @Cacheable/@CacheEvict annotations
loadup-components-cache-binder-caffeine Caffeine local cache implementation (LRU/LFU, auto-expiry, stats)
loadup-components-cache-binder-redis Redis distributed cache (persistence, replication, cluster, pub/sub)

Maven Dependencies link

<!-- API (always required) -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-cache-api</artifactId>
</dependency>

<!-- Choose ONE binder -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-cache-binder-caffeine</artifactId>
</dependency>
<!-- OR -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-cache-binder-redis</artifactId>
</dependency>

Configuration link

loadup:
  cache:
    type: caffeine             # caffeine | redis
    caffeine:
      maximum-size: 10000
      expire-after-write: 30m
    redis:
      key-prefix: "loadup:"
      default-ttl: 1h

Usage link

@Cacheable(cacheName = "user", key = "#userId")
public UserDTO getUser(String userId) { ... }

@CacheEvict(cacheName = "user", key = "#userId")
public void updateUser(String userId, UserUpdateCommand cmd) { ... }

item.title: DFS
item.description:
Overview link

Distributed File Storage with unified API (DfsService) and pluggable providers. Supports local filesystem, AWS S3 (and MinIO), and database BLOB storage — switch storage backends without changing application code.

Module Structure link

Module Purpose
loadup-components-dfs-api SPI interfaces, DfsService, models, DfsAutoConfiguration
loadup-components-dfs-binder-local Local filesystem provider with JSON metadata
loadup-components-dfs-binder-s3 S3-compatible (AWS S3, MinIO) provider
loadup-components-dfs-binder-database RDBMS BLOB provider (MySQL/PostgreSQL/H2)

Maven Dependencies link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-dfs-api</artifactId>
</dependency>
<!-- Choose ONE binder -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-dfs-binder-local</artifactId>
</dependency>

Configuration link

loadup:
  dfs:
    provider: local           # local | s3 | database
    local:
      storage-path: /data/files

Usage link

@Autowired
private DfsService dfsService;

// Upload
FileMetadata meta = dfsService.upload(new FileUploadRequest(file, "reports"));

// Download
FileDownloadResponse resp = dfsService.download(fileId);

item.title: Scheduler
item.description:
Overview link

Unified scheduling abstraction supporting four backends — lightweight SimpleJob (Spring TaskScheduler), enterprise Quartz (clustered), XXL-Job (visual admin), and PowerJob (next-gen with DAG workflows). Annotation-driven with @DistributedScheduler.

Module Structure link

Module Purpose
loadup-components-scheduler-api SPI interfaces, @DistributedScheduler, SchedulerTaskRegistry
loadup-components-scheduler-binder-simplejob Spring TaskScheduler (lightweight, single-instance)
loadup-components-scheduler-binder-quartz Quartz (enterprise, clustered, persistence)
loadup-components-scheduler-binder-xxljob XXL-Job (visual admin, sharding, dashboards)
loadup-components-scheduler-binder-powerjob PowerJob (DAG workflows, MapReduce tasks)

Maven Dependencies link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-scheduler-api</artifactId>
</dependency>
<!-- Choose ONE binder -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-scheduler-binder-simplejob</artifactId>
</dependency>

Configuration link

loadup:
  scheduler:
    type: simplejob           # simplejob | quartz | xxljob | powerjob

Usage link

@DistributedScheduler(cron = "0 */5 * * * ?", name = "cleanExpiredSessions")
public void cleanSessions() {
    log.info("Cleaning expired sessions...");
}

item.title: Gotone
item.description:
Overview link

Unified notification component (Gotone = “Go Tone”). ServiceCode-driven smart routing across Email (SMTP), SMS (Aliyun/Huawei/Tencent/Yunpian), Push (FCM), and Webhook (Dingtalk/Wechat/Feishu) channels. Single-table + JSON architecture for 73% less code vs traditional designs.

Module Structure link

Module Purpose
loadup-components-gotone-api SPI, domain model, GotoneNotificationService
loadup-components-gotone-core Core engine, smart routing, template rendering
loadup-components-gotone-starter Auto-configuration
loadup-components-gotone-channel-email SMTP email provider (HTML, attachments, CC/BCC)
loadup-components-gotone-channel-sms SMS providers (Aliyun/Huawei/Tencent/Yunpian)
loadup-components-gotone-channel-push FCM push notification provider
loadup-components-gotone-channel-webhook Webhook (Dingtalk/Wechat/Feishu)

Maven Dependencies link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-gotone-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>

Configuration link

loadup:
  gotone:
    enabled: true
    channels:
      email:
        host: smtp.example.com
        port: 587
        username: noreply@example.com
      sms:
        provider: aliyun

Usage link

@Autowired
private GotoneNotificationService gotoneService;

// Send via ServiceCode
SendResult result = gotoneService.send(new SendCommand(
    "WELCOME_EMAIL", recipient, Map.of("name", "User")
));

item.title: Tracer
item.description:
Overview link

OpenTelemetry 1.62.0 distributed tracing. Pluggable exporters (logging, Jaeger, Zipkin, Grafana Tempo) with multi-exporter fan-out and fallback chains. W3C TraceContext propagation, MDC injection, and async context propagation.

Maven Dependency link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-tracer</artifactId>
</dependency>

Configuration link

loadup:
  tracer:
    enabled: true
    exporters:
      - type: logging
      - type: jaeger
        endpoint: http://localhost:14250
    exclude-patterns: /actuator/**,/health

Usage link

// Annotation-driven
@Traced(spanName = "processOrder")
public void processOrder(Order order) { ... }

// Programmatic
TraceUtil.startSpan("customOperation");
try {
    // business logic
} finally {
    TraceUtil.endSpan();
}

item.title: Pipeline
item.description:
Overview link

Process orchestration engine with 4-phase standard flow (verify → prepare → process → assemble), type-safe Fluent DSL, IControlStage for conditional termination, IFinallyStage for guaranteed cleanup, and typed exception routing via ExceptionHandlerBus.

Maven Dependency link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-pipeline</artifactId>
</dependency>

Usage link

PipelineDefinition<OrderContext> pipeline = Pipeline.<OrderContext>builder()
    .verify(ctx -> validateOrder(ctx))
    .prepare(ctx -> enrichData(ctx))
    .process(ctx -> executeLogic(ctx))
    .assemble(ctx -> buildResponse(ctx))
    .onException(ValidationException.class, (ctx, e) -> handleError(ctx, e))
    .build();

OrderResult result = pipeline.execute(context);

item.title: RetryTask
item.description:
Overview link

Distributed retry task framework. Features: optimistic-lock preemption, flexible retry strategies (fixed interval, exponential backoff), bizType isolation, failure notifications, auto-cleanup, and anti-starvation scheduling.

Maven Dependency link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-retrytask-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>

Configuration link

loadup:
  retrytask:
    scheduler:
      enabled: true
      cron: "*/10 * * * * ?"
    max-retry-count: 5
    retry-interval: 60000

Usage link

@Component
public class PaymentRetryProcessor implements RetryTaskProcessor {
    @Override
    public boolean process(RetryTask task) {
        // Retry payment logic
        return true; // true = success, false = retry later
    }
}

item.title: Captcha
item.description:
Overview link

Java graphics captcha component (forked from EasyCaptcha). Supports GIF animation, Chinese characters, and arithmetic captcha types. Optimized character set removes ambiguous characters (0/O/1/I/l).

Maven Dependency link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-captcha</artifactId>
</dependency>

Usage link

// Generate PNG captcha
Captcha captcha = CaptchaUtil.createPngCaptcha(200, 100, 4);
String code = captcha.text();         // "A3K9"
captcha.write(response.getOutputStream());

// Generate GIF captcha
GifCaptcha gifCaptcha = CaptchaUtil.createGifCaptcha(200, 100, 5);
gifCaptcha.write(response.getOutputStream());

// Arithmetic captcha
ArithmeticCaptcha mathCaptcha = CaptchaUtil.createArithmeticCaptcha(200, 100);
String expression = mathCaptcha.getArithmeticString();  // "3+5=?"
int result = mathCaptcha.getResult();                   // 8

item.title: Authorization
item.description:
Overview link

Lightweight (~50KB) AOP-based method-level authorization. Annotation-driven with @RequireRole and @RequirePermission. Non-invasive — add to any Spring Bean method without restructuring.

Maven Dependency link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-authorization</artifactId>
</dependency>

Usage link

@Service
public class UserService {

    @RequireRole("ADMIN")
    public void deleteUser(String userId) { ... }

    @RequirePermission("user:create")
    public UserDTO createUser(CreateUserCommand cmd) { ... }

    @RequireRole(orRole = {"ADMIN", "MANAGER"})
    public List<UserDTO> listAllUsers() { ... }
}

item.title: Signature
item.description:
Overview link

Digital signature and digest component. Supports RSA/DSA/ECDSA signing, MD5/SHA/HMAC digests, key pair management, and type-safe algorithm enums. ~5000 RSA sign ops/sec.

Maven Dependency link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-signature</artifactId>
</dependency>

Configuration link

loadup:
  signature:
    algorithm: SHA256withRSA
    key-store:
      type: file
      path: /keys/private.pem

Usage link

@Autowired
private SignatureService signatureService;

// Sign
String signature = signatureService.sign(data, keyId);

// Verify
boolean valid = signatureService.verify(data, signature, keyId);

// Digest
String hash = DigestService.sha256("hello world");

item.title: GlobalUnique
item.description:
Overview link

Global idempotency control via database unique key constraints. Minimal design — no Redis dependency, no expiration, no status fields. Uses INSERT-and-check pattern with transaction consistency.

Maven Dependency link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-globalunique</artifactId>
</dependency>

Configuration link

loadup:
  globalunique:
    enabled: true
    db-type: MYSQL

Usage link

@Autowired
private GlobalUniqueService globalUniqueService;

// Simple check-and-insert
boolean success = globalUniqueService.insertAndCheck("ORDER_NO", "ORD-2026-001");

// With business data
String bizId = globalUniqueService.insertAndCheck(
    "PAYMENT", "TXN-001", requestData.toJson()
);

item.title: ConfigCenter
item.description:
Overview link

Unified configuration center with Binder/Binding architecture. Supports Local (YAML, no external deps), Nacos, and Apollo as interchangeable backends. Includes Spring @EnableConfigAutoRefresh for hot reload.

Module Structure link

Module Purpose
loadup-components-configcenter-api SPI interfaces, ConfigCenterBindingManager
loadup-components-configcenter-binder-local Local file-based config (YAML)
loadup-components-configcenter-binder-nacos Alibaba Nacos integration
loadup-components-configcenter-binder-apollo Apollo (Ctrip) integration

Maven Dependencies link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-configcenter-api</artifactId>
</dependency>
<!-- Choose ONE binder -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-configcenter-binder-local</artifactId>
</dependency>

Configuration link

loadup:
  configcenter:
    binder: local             # local | nacos | apollo

Usage link

@Autowired
private ConfigCenterBindingManager configManager;

String value = configManager.getString("app.timeout", "30");

item.title: Testcontainers
item.description:
Overview link

Enterprise Testcontainers base module supporting 7 container types (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, LocalStack). Flexible switching between containers and real services via annotations, config files, or programmatic API.

Maven Dependency link

<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.loadup-cloud</groupId>
    <artifactId>loadup-components-testcontainers</artifactId>
    <scope>test</scope>
</dependency>

Configuration link

testcontainers:
  reuse:
    enable: true              # Reuse containers for 80-90% faster tests
  containers:
    mysql:
      image: mysql:8.0
    redis:
      image: redis:7-alpine

Usage link

@SpringBootTest
@EnableTestContainers(ContainerType.MYSQL)
class MyServiceIT {
    // Real MySQL container started automatically
}
